darq.processing module

Per-subject registration pipeline: preprocessing → simulation → alignment → save.

Build the transforms used to simulate DaT uptake from the MRI striatal mask.

List of transforms applied to the simulated_dat entry.

list

darq.processing.process_fn_parallel(fn, *args, **kwargs)[source]

Safely execute a processing function inside a parallel worker.

Parameters:

  • fn – Function to call in the worker process.

  • args – Positional arguments forwarded to the processing function.

  • kwargs – Keyword arguments forwarded to the processing function.

Returns:

Function result, or None if the function raises an exception.

Return type:

dict | None
